description:
PR #16 review finding 2: https://github.com/jat10/zaq/pull/16
Reviewed head: 1b2637d9a5284ad7ed3febd9d175288f9dfc6897.

Problem
ChannelsLive.configuration_save_error/3 adds authoritative file-validation errors but retains the cached capability snapshot. If a limit changes from fixed to configurable and required while the editor is open, Engine correctly rejects the missing override, but BO keeps the old read-only presentation. Opening capabilities does not refresh because capabilities_error is still false. The user cannot correct the error without reopening the editor and losing the draft.

Evidence
A temporary LiveView probe reproduced the defect: open a connector with fixed max_attachment_bytes; change the bridge declaration to unresolved/configurable/required; submit Save; assert the required-field error is rendered while the corresponding input remains absent; open capabilities and assert the input is still absent. Storage remains unchanged. Local artifacts, if still available: /tmp/pr16_stale_ui_test.exs and /tmp/pr16-stale-ui.log. Recreate the regression in the owning suite rather than depending on temporary files. Main changed location: lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channels_live.ex, configuration_save_error/3 (reviewed lines 1355-1361). Inspect analogous SMTP and widget rejection handling for the same recovery requirement.

Agreed direction / Action reuse assessment
Reuse existing capability-loading paths, confidential NodeRouter/Event proposal inspection, shared capability normalization, FileSettings, FileDeliverySettings and ConnectionSettings. After an authoritative capability-validation rejection, refresh normalized declarations while retaining submitted drafts. The declarations must describe the effective proposed configuration, including proposed policy changes; fetching only the persisted configuration can give the wrong controls again. Evaluate the smallest compatible extension: return the evaluated normalized snapshot with the validation rejection, or retrieve it through the existing proposal event. Preserve existing public error contracts or update their consumers coherently; do not add a new endpoint, callback, provider-specific form logic or parallel validation implementation. Keep per-keystroke validation local and cached. Do not forward secrets in an error payload; return only allowlisted normalized capability facts.

Acceptance criteria
- After a rejected save caused by changed declarations, the editor renders the current configurable/required controls so the user can fix the error without closing it.
- Facts correspond to the final effective proposal, including policy-dependent declarations, not just persisted settings.
- All submitted drafts, credentials, explicit false policy values and inactive-panel values remain intact; appropriate error-section selection is preserved.
- Correcting the newly editable value and saving succeeds; rejected attempts leave stored settings unchanged.
- A failed refresh uses the existing recoverable capability-error/retry presentation and preserves drafts; successful empty/unsupported snapshots remain distinct from lookup failure.
- Generic, SMTP and widget editors follow the same recovery contract where applicable. Reuse shared helpers/components instead of duplicating behavior.
- Extend the existing stale-capability LiveView scenario with assertions for control refresh, retained drafts and successful correction. Add only distinct execution-path coverage needed for other save boundaries. Preserve existing assertions and obtain explicit approval before changing existing test behavior.
- Run mix q and isolated relevant suites through Context Mode. Follow the parent issue's pending UX, E2E, coverage and final-validation gates. This issue does not authorize commits, pushes, merges or restarting previously deferred final precommit.

Agent handoff
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md, docs/conventions.md, DESIGN.md, docs/bo-components.md and applicable Channels/Engine service sections. Read module responsibilities before editing. Scope this issue to finding 2; finding 1 is tracked separately as zaq-h2i.3.15. Coordinate any shared error/validation contract edits without assuming a dependency is required. User approved creating this issue; no implementation or delegation was performed in this turn.

comments.text: Reuse/extend: existing confidential ChannelConfig proposal validation now retains its normalized result on file-error metadata; grouped/widget projections optionally include :capabilities and SMTP retains metadata on the submitted form. Shared CapabilitySnapshot presentation helper consumes it, preserving all drafts and avoiding another request. Shared error formatter now interpolates only referenced metadata (required for structured capability facts). Context Mode mix q PASS; 292 isolated tests/properties PASS. Added fixed-to-required editor regression and stale ceiling control-refresh assertion. Additional boundary/retry coverage follows with .17. No existing expectations changed.

title: [zaq-h2i.3] Refresh capability declarations after rejected connector saves
